task: 0.3.1 Trace all durable writes from native tools, desktop, server, MCP, OpenClaw, sidecars, imports, cognition, lifecycle, goals, feedback, and tests to their actual store/transaction boundary.
method: Static source trace of durable-write primitives (WritePolicy.submit, Database::begin/AuthorityTx, direct rusqlite execute of INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, and separate Connection handles) plus live registration/composition roots (Tauri invoke_handler, Axum .route, tool registry build_registry, startup wiring). Classification requires a live registration/composition root; unresolved registration or mediation facts are recorded Unknown, never inferred optimistically. No secrets copied.
invariants_applied: Dormant code/comments/tests are not capability proof — classification traced to LIVE registration roots.
Single SQLite authority (MGR-033.1): one transactional authority for authoritative writes.
Single governed write boundary (MGR-035.1 / A3): every durable write must pass WritePolicyEngine.
Atomicity (A2): accepted write = authority rows + immutable event + audit + outbox + one graph revision, all-or-none.

governed_boundary.name: WritePolicyEngine (the intended single mandatory write gate, L3/A3/MGR-035.1)
governed_boundary.notes: submit() persists ONLY a raw event + audit row atomically; derived memory rows, entities, relationships, goals, feedback, library rows, conversations, facts are written by OTHER services that open their own AuthorityTx and DO NOT flow through submit().

low_level_authority_tx.name: Database::begin -> AuthorityTx (single serialized writer over kria_memory.db)
low_level_authority_tx.entry: crates/kria-core/src/memory/db/mod.rs Database::begin() (BEGIN IMMEDIATE, holds the write Mutex)
low_level_authority_tx.observation: AuthorityTx is directly obtainable by ANY holder of Arc<Database>. Every service in the memory module (goals, truth, merge, lifecycle, feedback, library, conversation, entity_resolution, graph_intel, planning, reasoning, dreaming, knowledge_gap, maintenance, retrieval_opt, runtime_backend, cold_start, create_relationship) calls db.begin() directly, so the AuthorityTx boundary — not WritePolicy — is the de-facto write boundary. This satisfies MGR-033 single-authority (one DB file) but VIOLATES MGR-035.1/A3 single governed write boundary.

write_boundaries.pragma_note: crates/kria-core/src/memory/db/mod.rs configure() sets synchronous=NORMAL, but MGR-033/design §4 require synchronous=FULL for authority commit — recorded for F1.1, out of scope for 0.3.1.

key_findings: MGR-035.1 / A3 VIOLATED (single governed write boundary): WritePolicy::submit persists only a raw event + audit row. All derived/semantic durable writes — relationships (create_relationship api.rs:812), goals, feedback, truth/supersession, merges, library items/chunks, conversations, legacy memory_facts, entities/aliases/mentions, cognition engine outputs (plans/reasoning/dream/gaps), lifecycle deletes, cold-start consent — open their own Database::begin() AuthorityTx and BYPASS WritePolicy. The de-facto write boundary is AuthorityTx, obtainable by any holder of Arc<Database>.

MGR-033.1 PARTIALLY HELD (single authority): the cognitive memory model lives in one file (kria_memory.db) with one primary serialized-writer handle, BUT mobile_gateway.rs:116 opens a SECOND independent Database handle (separate connection pool) to the same file, and durable app state fans out to FOUR additional SQLite files (kria.db, skills.db, cpp_grants.db, devices.db).

COMPETING SEMANTIC AUTHORITIES: (a) legacy memory_facts/facts_fts model in runtime_backend.rs is a distinct fact representation from the events/memories authority (same DB, different schema lineage — migration 0005); (b) world_facts in kria.db (WorldModelStore/PSDG) is a SECOND semantic-fact store. Both are cutover/reconciliation targets for MGR-033.8.

MGR-005 concern (governed relationship writes): relationship creation (create_relationship, graph_intel predictions, extraction) writes edges directly with no WritePolicy admission, no atomic event/audit, and no graph-revision reservation — contradicting A2 atomicity for graph-visible changes.

THREE separate rusqlite::Connection handles to kria.db (TaskStore, WorldModelStore/PSDG, QuarantineRegistry) plus safety AuditLogger, SqliteConfigStore, and BriefingStore share one file with NO shared transaction and NO governed boundary — many-writers-one-file.

GOVERNED FUNNEL that DOES hold: native-tool / MCP / OpenClaw / sidecar OUTCOMES reach durable memory only through AgentLoop::observe_user_turn (loop_engine:4970) and record_agent_outcome (:5131) -> WritePolicy::submit; and OpenClaw lifecycle via observe_capability_lifecycle -> record_capability. These are correctly governed.

SECURITY (out of 0.3.1 classification scope, flagged for MGR-003/F1): server /memory/* write routes are mounted under CorsLayer::permissive() (lib.rs:90) and auth.rs allows requests with no Authorization header through — unauthenticated remote memory writes if the server binds non-loopback.
PRAGMA gap: authority connections use synchronous=NORMAL (db/mod.rs configure), while MGR-033/design §4 require synchronous=FULL for authority commit — recorded for F1.1.
